newsitem.title: USA: Xerox rises on renewed optimism.
newsitem.headline: Xerox rises on renewed optimism.

text.p: Xerox Corp shares rose on Thursday amid what analysts described as optimism about the document processing and copier company.
Xerox rose 1-3/4 to 51-1/4 in mid-afternoon on volume of 2.4 million shares. The share price has struggled back from the mid-40s in early November following poorer-than-expected earnings results.
"I think that in the past week or so the stock has been pretty much picking up," said Wendy Abramowitz, an analyst with Argus Research.
She said there had been too much concern about Xerox adding reserves and Kohlberg Kravis & Roberts' cancellation of its $2.7 billion purchase of insurance units from the company.
